msg: Good morning, we are two Belgian divers (both Advanced) staying at a hotel on Isla Grande from the 8th to the 12th. We would like to dive on two different days and do one night dive. We fly home from Cartagena on the 13th at 7 a.m. What do you recommend, and can we pay in euros in cash when we arrive?
reply:
Hi! 🪸 I'm *Coral* from *Diving Planet* — we dive year-round in the Rosario Islands, departing from Cartagena or right from the islands. 🌊

Good morning! Diving from Isla Grande is a lovely way to explore the Rosario Islands. Since you’re already staying there, the **3-dive package** is the closest fit: two daytime dives plus one night dive in a single day. You can choose which day to do it, subject to the booking calendar.

The 3-dive package’s booking link is https://book.divingplanet.org/book/package-of-3-dives-already-on-island/22?language=en. The 2-dive option is here: https://book.divingplanet.org/book/fun-dives-already-on-island/19?language=en.

Please note the flight timing: after diving, you must wait at least **18 hours before flying**. A dive on the 12th may not leave enough time before your 7 a.m. flight on the 13th, so plan your final dive earlier.

*Prices per person* (online · regular):
• Fun Dives - 2 dives (1 day): 124 USD · 138 USD
• 3-dive package (1 day, 2 daytime + 1 night dive): 188 USD · 209 USD

Payment is **100% by card through the online booking link**; international bookings are paid in USD, so cash in euros on arrival isn’t an available payment method.

Guests who are not Colombian or residents of Colombia pay in US dollars (USD) by card on the website; the rate is the same, only the currency changes.

Would you like me to connect you with a team advisor to help arrange the two dive days?
